test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said, "I did not enjoy the trip to Goa due to continuous rains."

options.text: She said that she had not enjoyed the trip to Goa due to continuous rains.
She said that I had not enjoyed the trip to Goa due to continuous rains.
She said that she did not enjoy the trip to Goa due to continuous rains.
She said that I did not enjoy the trip to Goa due to continuous rains.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She said that she had not enjoyed the trip to Goa due to continuous rains'.**
